sentences.text: Margot Betty Frank -LRB- February 16 , 1926 -- February 1945 -RRB- was the eldest daughter of Otto Frank and Edith Frank and the older sister of Anne Frank .	Anne Frank	Anne Frank	Otto Frank	Otto Frank	Edith Frank	Edith Frank
Margot 's deportation order from the Gestapo hastened the Frank family into hiding .	Gestapo	Gestapo
According to the diary of her younger sister , Anne , Margot kept a diary of her own , but no trace of Margot 's diary has ever been found .
She died in Bergen-Belsen .	Bergen-Belsen	Bergen-Belsen concentration camp
